diagnostics.message: `:resource.aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers.this` associates EC2 capacity providers with the cluster, but its `capacity_providers` list is built only from the names supplied in `var.autoscaling_capacity_providers` — it never references `:resource.aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this` (the value that is actually created from those inputs). The dependency only flows through the `local.cluster_capacity_providers` local used in the `default_capacity_provider_strategy` block, which the graph does not record, so Terraform may attempt to associate a capacity provider before `:resource.aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this` exists, and AWS rejects the association ("capacity provider not found"). Add an explicit dependency (or reference the created capacity providers' names directly).

fix.expression: distinct(concat([for k, v in var.fargate_capacity_providers : try(v.name, k)], [for k, v in aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this : v.name]))
